s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of her nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass noted on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis present
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

shortlist.label: Giant cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells, consistent with giant cell tumor

shortlist.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the maxillary sinus with erosion of surrounding structures, consistent with aggressive tumor behavior

shortlist.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the maxillary sinus with involvement of the nasal septum and orbit, consistent with esthesioneuroblastoma

shortlist.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive mass in the maxillary sinus with erosion of surrounding structures, consistent with malignant tumor

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning, consistent with fibrous dysplasia

raw.rationale: The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells and rare mitotic activity, along with the imaging findings of a heterogeneous mass with bony erosion and remodeling, are consistent with a giant cell tumor.

rejected.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
rejected.why: Typically occurs in adolescent males and is highly vascular, which is not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
rejected.why: Usually presents with a mass in the nasal cavity and has a distinct neuroblastic appearance on biopsy, not seen in this case

rejected.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with more aggressive features and cytologic atypia, which is not present in this case

rejected.label: Fibrous dysplasia
rejected.why: Typically presents with ground-glass appearance on imaging and does not usually have a distinct mass or multinucleated giant cells on biopsy

gold: Left maxillary giant cell reparative granuloma (GCRG)
